Axiom:
**Files carry a unified file-header contract; IDs only, never paths; append-only for `@tasks`.**
Required file-level fields in execution profile: - `@file` — mandatory; what the file holds. - `@consumers` — mandatory; one or more consumers (see `AX_CONSUMERS_TAG_SEMANTICS`). - `@tasks` — mandatory; associated `TSK-NN` list.
Canonical header shape: ``` // @file: // @consumers: // @tasks: TSK-04, TSK-12 ```
